paymentProof.title: Prove this payment
paymentProof.intro: Creates a proof that this transaction paid that address that amount. Anyone can check it against the chain; it says nothing about your balance or your other payments.
paymentProof.includeMemo: Include the private note in the proof
paymentProof.disclosureNote: Whoever holds this proof learns this one payment — the recipient, the amount, and the note if you included it. Nothing else.
paymentProof.errNone: This payment cannot be proven: it was sent before the wallet kept recoverable details.
paymentProof.errNotJson: That is not a payment proof.
paymentProof.verifyIntro: Paste a proof somebody sent you. The chain decides — no trust in them or in us.
paymentProof.verifyNote: The proof is checked against the transaction on chain: the disclosed recipient and amount must reproduce the commitment the block recorded.
